description: Cost-sensitive threshold optimization sweeping cost of missed failure (FN) to cost of false alarm (FP) from 1:1 to 100:1
takeaway: Threshold 0.515 maximizes F1-score (0.8936) by balancing precision and recall under symmetric loss. However, in real-world predictive maintenance where unplanned downtime costs 10x-100x more than preventive false alarms, the cost-optimal threshold shifts aggressively lower: to 0.300 at 10:1 ratio (saving 13.8% cost), 0.050 at 50:1 ratio (saving 40.7% cost), and 0.015 at 100:1 ratio (saving 54.3% cost). Lowering the threshold dramatically boosts recall (from 83.7% to 99.0%), eliminating costly catastrophic failures.
